scope: Synthetic in-memory complete native macro_step; no Gabriel owner, durable storage, scientific validation or financial predictor

engine.warmup: one fresh 8-tick engine per entity count, outside reported repetitions
engine.freshness: fresh GlobalState per repetition; process-global packed/index/cache and memoized thread cache retain state
engine.timing: Instant around 8 macro_step calls including per-tick timer/recording, returned crystal drop and black_box; excludes input/config/GlobalState construction, final state drop, shape checks and JSON
engine.golden: exact output bytes of all per-tick selected state snapshots and complete SemanticCrystal values, three builds; snapshot field scope matches prior focused harness
engine.shape: every tick commits; every crystal region equals source count; signature Some with matching n for 3/5/7, None for 8
engine.graph_scope: these sources form complete region graphs; 8-source workload bypasses bounded signature as a negative control
engine.statistic: per external pair: ratio of per-process median observation throughput across 25 fresh repetitions; report median and range of five paired ratios

first_macrostep.freshness: new executable process per entity count per variant per pair; no preceding macro_step, golden, signature, or warmup in that process
first_macrostep.timing: only first macro_step including its internal lazy initialization; process launch, input/config/GlobalState construction, output inspection/drop/serialization excluded
first_macrostep.cache_warning: fresh process is not a cold OS page cache; no page-cache flushing
first_macrostep.statistic: reference elapsed_ns divided by candidate elapsed_ns within each alternating pair; report all five values and median/range

micro.same_binary: memoized-engine executable contains all three complete signature functions
micro.fixed: 512 calls of the complete graph at n, matching full-engine graph shape
micro.changing: 512 frozen xorshift64 graph words per n; not necessarily unique (only eight possible n=3 graphs); distinct count in inputs.json
micro.timing: full signature API (validation, orbit selection, canonical hash, spectral and subgraph fields), black_box and output drop; owned adjacency cloning/construction, diagnostics and serialization excluded
micro.warmup: per n/workload/comparison: clear memo cache, one untimed 512-call pass of each comparison function; cache persists through seven timed pairs
micro.golden: complete pse_types::canonical_bytes output for fixed, all 512 changing and all collision inputs from each of three functions in same executable, exact bytes compared before timing
micro.diagnostics: memoizer cumulative per-thread counters sampled before/after each pass outside timer; implementation counter increments remain part of function cost
micro.statistic: reference elapsed_ns divided by candidate elapsed_ns within each alternating pair; report all seven values and median/range
micro.collision: 512 alternating calls of two distinct same-n labelled graph words with different edge counts mapped to the same memoizer slot; n5/n7 only; n3 has no within-size slot collision. Untimed preflight requires all second-pass calls to miss and evict.
micro.collision_slot_formula: word=bits|(n<<21); mixed=word*0x9e3779b1 wrapping u32; slot=(mixed^(mixed>>16))&255; fixture freezes actual colliding words

execution_order: untimed memo cache diagnostics including collision assertions
interpretation: Ratios are local synthetic measurements with explicit noise/ranges; do not multiply by historical ratios or claim general application/model speedups
profile_rationale: All three variants use LTO disabled as a local linking workaround after Rust 1.95.0 ThinLTO link attempts failed with undefined symbols. This records an observed build workaround, not a diagnosis. These same-profile local ratios must not be multiplied by historical ThinLTO ratios.
build_cache: All builds share output/target/build for untimed Cargo dependency reuse. Immediately after each successful build its executable is copied to output/target/binaries/<variant>, byte-hash verified, and all later golden/measurement commands execute those preserved copies. Exact copied binary hashes are recorded.
